_readme: Every number here that is not measured by replay.py. Replace each with pilot time-study data (see time_study_template.csv), then re-run python -m evals.roi.roi. 'source' says where each value came from.

baseline_minutes_per_package.source: Client: one person takes ~4 h to do Phase 1 for a funding package.

tasks._source: ASSUMED split of the 240 min across the Phase 1 scope in the Initial Funding design doc (section 15). Not measured.

intake.label: Intake: pull request email + attachments, build package folder

wire_extraction.label: Wire extraction: key beneficiary, bank, ABA, account, addresses

cross_doc.label: Cross-document validation: ISS vs email vs wire (amounts, fees, fund, dates)

exceptions.label: Exceptions: identify, document, call-back on masked/conflicting values

outputs.label: Outputs: IF triage workbook, BOA CashPro CSV, BCMP wet-funding values

_phase1_residual: ASSUMED share of each task's minutes still done by a person once that task is automated (review, approvals, calls). wire_extraction is null because it is measured: its residual is the review time below.

review._source: ASSUMED reviewer minutes. Every row is checked against the source PDF (retained human control); flagged fields need extra work; failed rows are keyed by hand.

volume_packages_per_month.source: Treasury use-case diagram: 'Monthly volume is ~100 loans and growing'; each loan has one initial funding package. 3%/month growth is ASSUMED.

loaded_cost_per_hour_usd.source: ASSUMED fully loaded Accounting staff cost.

run_cost._source: Azure Retail Prices API (prices.azure.com), eastus2, Global Standard, pulled 2026-10-08: gpt-6-luna short context $0.10 / 1M input, $0.50 / 1M output tokens; Mistral Document AI 2512 $3.00 / 1,000 pages (Data Zone: $0.11 / $0.55 and $3.30). Tokens for image reads are measured (evals/gpt-6-luna/results.json); luna-on-OCR-text input is ESTIMATED from prompt + schema + page text length.

mistral-ocr+gpt-6-luna.calls: 1 x Mistral Document AI + 1 x gpt-6-luna on OCR text

run_cost._hosting: ASSUMED: Azure Functions + Storage + Application Insights for ~100-300 packages/month.

mistral-ocr+gpt-6-luna-extract.calls: 1 x Mistral Document AI + 1 x gpt-6-luna on OCR text

phase1_run_cost._source: ASSUMED: Phase 1 also reads the internal settlement statement (ISS) and the request email for cross-document checks. Priced at the same Azure rates as the wire step (Mistral Document AI $3.00 / 1,000 pages; gpt-6-luna $0.10 / $0.50 per 1M tokens). Hosting: Phase 0 carries the base Azure hosting; Phase 1 adds mailbox/SharePoint automation and storage.

preferred_config.source: The setup built into the service (OCR_PROVIDER=mistral): Mistral reads the page, gpt-6-luna extracts. Reports use it when it is safe and no live run exists.
